jobs.prompt: Cinematic film still, anamorphic widescreen composition, photorealistic, highly detailed, sharp, no people. Interior of a circular stone observatory room at the top of an ancient mountain tower. Rough grey stone walls, a tall arched leaded-glass window on the far wall showing a grey sky with falling ash and a pale dead sun disc. Tall brass clockwork and gear machines, unlit hanging brass lanterns, shelves of old books and tools, a heavy oak workbench with several lit candles, a low stone table in the middle of the room. Low-key warm candlelight from the workbench, cool grey daylight from the window, thin dust in the light shafts, deep brown shadows.

Cinematic film still, anamorphic widescreen composition, photorealistic, highly detailed, sharp, no people. A vast valley of grey ash dunes under a grey-white overcast sky with a pale dead sun disc low on the horizon. Colossal fallen stone statues of ancient kings, a giant stone head and a broken stone hand, each many times taller than a person, half-buried in ash. Dead black trees. Soft ash falling like snow, distant mountains fading into haze. Cold desaturated grey-blue palette, soft top light, deep atmospheric perspective.

Cinematic film still, anamorphic widescreen composition, photorealistic, highly detailed, sharp, no people. A narrow ancient stone bridge with broken balustrades and weathered carved pillars spanning a bottomless dark chasm between two cliffs, some sections of the bridge missing, an ash storm with wind-driven ash, lightning flashing inside dark clouds behind, stormy dusk. Near-black blues, white-violet lightning backlight, strong silhouettes.

Cinematic film still, anamorphic widescreen composition, photorealistic, highly detailed, sharp, no people. A high rocky cliff top at the edge of the world above an endless sea of clouds at blue hour. A colossal ancient upright stone ring, many times taller than a person, carved with sun runes, standing at the cliff edge; a wide brass brazier on a stone dais at its foot. Clear still air, deep blue sky with the last stars, soft cool light.

Cinematic film still, anamorphic widescreen composition, photorealistic, highly detailed, sharp, no people. A high rocky cliff top at the edge of the world above an endless sea of clouds at sunrise. A colossal ancient upright stone ring, many times taller than a person, carved with sun runes, standing at the cliff edge; a wide brass brazier on a stone dais at its foot. A brilliant new golden sun rising inside the stone ring, warm golden light flooding across the cloud sea, god rays through the ring, long shadows, gold and pink clouds.
